name: StoreKit 2 subscriptions and paywall
description: Load subscription products, purchase, restore and track entitlements with StoreKit 2, a paywall view, and a local StoreKit configuration for simulator testing.

cost.note: Apple keeps a commission on digital sales; selling requires an Apple Developer Program membership and paid-apps agreement

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Create `StoreModel(productIDs: StoreProducts.all, service: StoreKitPurchaseService())` at the composition root. Present `PaywallView(model:features:)` (features is a list of short strings). Gate premium features on `model.isPremium`. Attach `.task { await model.load() }` and `.task { await model.listenForTransactions() }` once near the root. Only for digital goods and subscriptions used in the app; those must use StoreKit, never Apple Pay or Stripe. Physical goods and services used outside the app (food, rides, merchandise, tickets) must not use StoreKit: choose apple-pay and say why in the plan.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify storekit2-paywall` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
